title: Rough set machine learning reveals governing factors of biochar-facilitated carbamazepine removal from water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00768B, Paper
Nidesh Prasad, Muhil Raj Prabhakar, Chong Liu, Sivaraman Chandrasekaran, Bikash Chandra Maharaj, Paramasivan Balasubramanian
An interpretable RSML model guides biochar use to efficiently remove a persistent drug (carbamazepine) from wastewater, achieving 93% accuracy with actionable rules.
